column1: # Waffen SS\PeG-WW2 Readme.txt · 译文填写表：只改第三列（译文），其余别动

column2: This PG2 campaign of John McNulty has been converted for PeG-WW2 by Mark Kirby in 2000.
column3: John McNulty 的这个 PG2 战役已由 Mark Kirby 于 2000 年移植为 PeG-WW2 版本。

column2: Download all files in the SCENARIO directory of PeG-WW2, since file names have not been modified they will just replace the existing ones of version 1.0.
column3: 请下载 PeG-WW2 的 SCENARIO 目录中的所有文件；由于文件名未作修改，它们会直接替换 1.0 版的现有文件。

column2: No download of maps is needed since all SSI maps are already included with the PeG-WW2 installer programme.
column3: 无需下载地图，因为所有 SSI 地图都已包含在 PeG-WW2 安装程序中。

column2: Changes to Mark Kirby's campaign conversion
column3: 对 Mark Kirby 战役转换版的改动

column2: * I have added references to movies in the CAM file.
column3: * 我在 CAM 文件中加入了影片引用。

column2: The following movies have been used: NewGMWin, Medalgem, Gerloss, 1, 2, Fas3, 4, finn-01, Fas2, Wdunkirk, Fas9, victory1940, Fas11, Fas13, 11, Kursk, 16, Fas15, 17.
column3: 使用了以下影片：NewGMWin, Medalgem, Gerloss, 1, 2, Fas3, 4, finn-01, Fas2, Wdunkirk, Fas9, victory1940, Fas11, Fas13, 11, Kursk, 16, Fas15, 17。

column2: Download movies in SMK format at Adlerkorps website: http://www.adlerkorps.com/
column3: 请在 Adlerkorps 网站下载 SMK 格式的影片：http://www.adlerkorps.com/

column2: The PeG-WW2 game readme file explains how to convert SMK movies into AVI format.
column3: PeG-WW2 游戏说明文件介绍了如何把 SMK 影片转换为 AVI 格式。

column2: * Campaign introduction text file has been changed.
column3: * 战役介绍文本文件已作修改。

column2: * I have also added Waffen SS country as member of the coalition in each scenario of the campaign, so that Waffen SS units would become purchasable with future PeG 3.0 engine.
column3: * 我还在战役的每个场景中把武装党卫军国家加为联军成员，这样武装党卫军单位在将来的 PeG 3.0 引擎中就可以购买。

column2: * Scenarios have not been changed compared with version 1 of this campaign (except the coalition with country nr 15).
column3: * 与这个战役的 1 版相比，各场景没有改动（除了与 15 号国家的联军关系）。

column2: * A Waffen SS.XLS file shows now the campaign path.
column3: * 现在有一个 Waffen SS.XLS 文件显示战役路线。

column2: * I have added the original PG2 readme file of John McNulty.
column3: * 我加入了 John McNulty 的原始 PG2 说明文件。
